answer: Each identity must receive one uniquely serialized optical token by post and activate it only during local dawn in its declared time zone, while locking 2,400 units for 21 days. The token records the first violet band of that sunrise; cloned firmware or a reused courier trail voids the key and burns the bond. Couriers leave each packet beside a numbered basalt marker at the claimed address, so one stoop cannot supply a farm. An honest operator buys one token and parks 2,400 units. Fielding 160 aliases requires 160 distinct deliveries and 384,000 units left idle.
